description: This Java class handles the creation of a Product Mix in the loan portfolio module. It implements the command handler interface, processes commands to create product mixes, and invokes the service layer to perform the creation logic.

classes.name: CreateProductMixCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles commands to create a product mix, delegating to the write platform service, and ensuring transactional integrity.

methods.name: CreateProductMixCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ProductMixWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the create product mix command by calling the service layer and returning the result.
